title: Apple Resting HR and Walking Pace Divergence
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=apple:health
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(resting_hr) as resting_hr, avg(walking_pace_sec_km) as walking_pace_sec_km by person _time
| streamstats window=4 current=f avg(resting_hr) as baseline_rhr, avg(walking_pace_sec_km) as baseline_pace by person
| where baseline_rhr>0 AND resting_hr>baseline_rhr+5 AND walking_pace_sec_km>baseline_pace+30
| sort - _time
description: Uses Apple Health cardio metrics telemetry to monitor resting heart rate alongside easy walking pace in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for fatigue patterns where both recovery and everyday speed worsened together, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Apple Health cardio metrics data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly trend of resting heart rate and walking pace.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges resting heart rate alongside easy walking pace so you can spot fatigue patterns where both recovery and everyday speed worsened together before it becomes annoying.
